channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Syria sentences Assad-era grand mufti to life in prison
item.description: A Syrian court sentences former grand mufti Ahmed Hassoun to life in prison after convicting him of inciting civil war and intentional killing.

item.title: Netherlands pulls out of 2027 Eurovision over Israel and Gaza war
item.description: The Netherlands will skip Eurovision 2027, claiming the Gaza war and Israel's participation have undermined the contest's political neutrality.

item.title: 'Disgraceful and shameful' | MK Sukkot demands arrest of PA police officers
item.description: MK Tzvi Sukkot visits scene where an Israeli reservist was attacked by PA police officers, calls on defense establishment to bring those involved to justice.

item.title: US offers up to $10 million for information on five senior IRGC commanders
item.description: US State Department is offering up to $10 million and possible relocation for information on five senior Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps commanders.

item.title: Erdan on Gaza border: Explosive kites are back - time to make Hamas pay a heavy price
item.description: Unity Party chairman Gilad Erdan and Col. (res.) Hezi Nechama tour the Gaza border area following the renewed launch of explosive kites, call for a change in policy.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed distances campaign from Hasan Piker after antisemitic remarks
item.description: Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed distances his campaign from Hasan Piker after the streamer’s remarks about Jewish Americans spark renewed controversy.

item.title: Report: IDF carries out strike in central Gaza
item.description: Palestinian Arab media reported early Tuesday that the IDF carried out a strike in central Gaza.

item.title: Poll: Winter’s party sends right-wing bloc to new low
item.description: New poll examines a scenario in which Ofer Winter’s party runs independently. In that scenario, the Religious Zionist Party fails to cross the electoral threshold and the right-wing bloc falls to 49 seats.

item.title: Two men injured in shooting in Baka al-Gharbiyyeh, criminal motive suspected
item.description:
Two men were seriously and moderately injured in a shooting in Baka al-Gharbiyyeh. Magen David Adom (MDA) medics and paramedics evacuated them to Hillel Yaffe Hospital in Hadera.
Police forces are at the scene, collecting evidence and investigating the incident. The shooting is believed to have been criminally motivated.

item.title: Iran vows to withstand new US sanctions, says Washington faces 'another defeat'
item.description: Iran's economy minister says Tehran has a two-year plan to counter new US sanctions after Washington announces a sweeping economic campaign.

item.title: Report: Oil tanker hit by unidentified missile near Oman
item.description:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported a maritime incident approximately nine nautical miles northeast of Oman, during which an oil tanker was struck by an unidentified missile. The impact damaged the tanker’s engine room, but no crew members were injured.
According to the organization, the environmental impact of the incident is not yet known.

item.title: Trump administration removes Syria from US list of state sponsors of terrorism
item.description: The Trump administration removes Syria from the US terror list, easing sanctions and opening the door to investment and reintegration into global markets.

item.title: IDF detects suspicious activity near Jordan Valley border; searches underway
item.description:
IDF surveillance systems detected suspicious movement along the eastern border in the Jordan Valley area on Monday evening.
IDF forces are conducting searches in the area to rule out a border crossing, while roads in the vicinity are being blocked as troops work to locate the suspects.

item.title: Hegseth clarifies: US not ruling out military strikes against Iran
item.description: US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth says Washington is not ruling out military strikes against Iran despite its new campaign of economic pressure.

item.title: Netanyahu welcomes new US sanctions on Iran: A steep price
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu welcomes new US sanctions against Iran, praising Trump and Bessent for imposing a steep price on the regime.

item.title: Israel’s demand: Stop kite terrorism
item.description: An urgent Israeli demand was conveyed to the Board of Peace to address the launching of terror kites within three days in order to prevent a major military escalation in the Gaza Strip.

item.title: Victim to Arutz Sheva: PA security forces lied, they attacked me
item.description: IDF reservist Yisrael Rosenthal recounts to Arutz Sheva his assault and detention by Palestinian Authority security forces in Area C and calls for action.

item.title: Border Police blocked the road, residents entered on foot
item.description: Residents sought to reach the “Outposts Route" to protest the arrest of a Jewish man by Palestinian Authority police. Security forces attempted to prevent them from holding the protest.

item.title: Iranian official: US economic sanctions plan an attempt to harm the Iranian people
item.description: Senior Iranian official tells Tasnim News Agency that the US economic sanctions program is a campaign aimed at increasing psychological pressure on the Iranian people.

item.title: US removes Syria from list of state sponsors of terrorism
item.description: The United States has removed Syria from its list of countries that "sponsor terrorism."

item.title: Operation Economic Outcast: Bessent declares 'economic onslaught' on Iran's economy
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent holds a press conference to announce new sanctions and economic measures against Iran.

item.title: IDF arrests son of terrorist slain last week, terror attack foiled
item.description: IDF and Shin Bet forces arrest Jenin terrorist Imam Hazzam, who allegedly planned an attack after his father was eliminated during a stabbing attempt.

item.title: IDF destroys Hamas weapons storage caches in Gaza mosques
item.description: According to the IDF, dozens of rifles were stored inside the Shati and Deir al-Balah area mosques in violation of international law.

item.title: 'Israel returns to containment': Additional kite from Gaza found in Gaza envelope
item.description: Fifth kite from Gaza lands in Israeli territory, found in Nahal Oz. Regional Council Chairman: 'Israel is returning to its policy of containment and reactivity instead of initiative.'

item.title: Details of operation to locate the Altalena revealed
item.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu and Ministers Ben Gvir and Eliyahu present details of the operation to locate the Altalena and the findings that were discovered.

item.title: Haredi extremists protest, Geha Interchange blocked
item.description: Extremists blocked the Geha Interchange, in the Petah Tikva and Bnei Brak area, as well as Jabotinsky Street, which separates the two cities, in protest against the arrest of a Haredi draft dodger.

item.title: ‘They beat and kicked me’: Reservist recounts detention by PA Forces
item.description: IDF reservist says PA officers beat him, sprayed him with pepper spray, seized his weapon and took him handcuffed into Ramallah after stopping his car in Area C.

item.title: Netanyahu and Katz presented with data showing decline in terrorism
item.description: The Prime Minister and Defense Minister held a situational assessment at Central Command. Minister Katz: “The number of terrorist attacks in Judea and Samaria has fallen to levels we have never seen before."
